facts.what: 把水晶收回绒袋：粉石英求被爱、紫水晶求安静
facts.anchor: a polished pink rose quartz to evoke the feeling of being loved

facts.what: 有水晶手册却不用，自嘲「只有我需要说明书才被爱」
facts.anchor: only I could require a manual to be loved by the most perfect man in the world

facts.what: 仍留 22 号旧宅钥匙、续租但骗 Fin 说在履行三个月通知期
facts.anchor: Fin thinks I’m honouring three months’ notice on my tenancy agreement

facts.what: 突然回家，门撞响、茶蜡飞散烫到她手臂
facts.anchor: the front door smashes like a symbol against the crown of my head

facts.what: 骂她「nonsense」「hippy shit」，说最好一把火烧掉
facts.anchor: Or even better, torched the lot.

facts.what: 被 nonsense 一词打回童年：被说太怪、太超过、有毛病
facts.anchor: She’s been told she’s too weird, too much, that there’s something wrong with her.

facts.what: 担心女友被找到、怕他想要她回来
facts.anchor: What if she’s been found? The girlfriend.

facts.what: 把一切归罪自己；浴室水声一响他换温和语气叫她进来
facts.anchor: He’s not even mad at all. He’s fine. Everything is fine. It’s me again, isn’t it? I’m the problem.

relations: Cassie 与 Finlay 同居；他反对她的灵性用品；她继续自责
